params.label: Strand length
params.help: How much of the path each strand covers.

params.label: Bend
params.help: The radius of the curve from the fall onto the floor.

params.label: Fan out
params.help: How wide the strands spread along the floor. The bass breathes it, as much as the layer's Motion says.

params.label: Meander
params.help: How far the strands wander off the path, together, like water finding its way.

params.label: Dust
params.help: Specks streaming along the path, quicker than the strands.

params.label: Beat wave
params.help: A wave of light running down the path on each beat.

params.label: Camera
params.help: Front: low over the floor, facing the fall. Side: the bend seen from the side. Inside: close beside the strands as they come round.

params.label: Depth of field
params.help: Strands nearer or further than the bend go soft and wide.

params.label: Colour along
params.help: How far the colours move along the palette from the top of the fall to the floor.
